relationships.subject: BML-111

relationships.evidence_quote: RvD1 was able to completely restore this TNF-α-induced barrier defect (Fig. 7l).

key_findings: Only capillary barrier tightness to fibrinogen recovered with pain resolution after CCI; endoneurial fibrinogen elevated in painful human polyneuropathy
Fpr2 agonist BML-111 and RvD1-laden nanoparticles accelerated pain resolution and fibrinogen clearance without changing Tnfα or Nlrp3
